His journey from the discovery of his extraordinary talent as the lead of the Jackson Five, to the visionary artist whose creative ambition fueled a relentless pursuit to become the biggest entertainer in the world, highlighting both his life off-stage and some of the most iconic performances from his early solo career.

synopsis:
As Miranda Priestly (Meryl Streep) nears retirement, she reunites with Andy Sachs (Anne Hathaway) to face off against Emily Charlton (Emily Blunt), her former assistant turned rival, as they compete for advertising revenue amidst declining print media.

Twenty years after making their iconic turns as Miranda, Andy, Emily and Nigel- Meryl Streep, Anne Hathaway, Emily Blunt and Stanley Tucci return to the fashionable streets of New York City and the sleek offices of Runway Magazine in 20th Century Studios’ “The Devil Wears Prada 2,” the eagerly awaited sequel to the 2006 phenomenon that defined a generation.

The Devil Wears Prada 2 reunites the original main cast of Meryl Streep, Anne Hathaway, Emily Blunt, and Stanley Tucci with director David Frankel and writer Aline Brosh McKenna. It also introduces an all-new runway of characters including Kenneth Branagh, Simone Ashley, Justin Theroux, Lucy Lui and more. The film also features an original song ""Runway"" performed by Lady Gaga and Doechii.
tmdb_overview: Miranda Priestly navigates her career amid the decline of traditional magazine publishing. She faces off against Emily Charlton, her one-time assistant, now a high-powered executive for a luxury group, with advertising dollars that Priestly desperately needs.

synopsis:
‘A Cornish modern classic. Eerie, heart-breaking, wonderful.’ - Mark Kermode 

When a fishing boat, the Rose of Nevada, lost with all hands 30 years ago, mysteriously reappears in the old harbour of a forgotten Cornish village, for those who remember, it’s surely a sign. The boat must go out to sea again and maybe then the luck of the devastated village will turn. 
Young father Nick (George MacKay) and enigmatic newcomer Liam (Callum Turner) join captain Murgey (Francis Magee), and they head to sea. But when they return, satisfied with their haul, something is amiss — they’ve slipped back in time, and the villagers greet them as if they are the original crew. 

Rose of Nevada is Cornish filmmaker Mark Jenkin’s hotly anticipated and critically acclaimed follow-up to his BAFTA-award-winning first feature Bait (2019) and Enys Men (2022). Unique among British feature filmmakers for the analogue way in which he crafts his films, Jenkin once again serves as writer, director, director of photography, editor, sound designer and score composer.

Beyond screens every Monday matinee and Tuesday evening, showcasing independent films that might not be on your radar (yet!) but are well worth experiencing on the big screen.

Starring returning cast members Jessica McNamee, Josh Lawson, Ludi Lin, Damon Herriman (in a different role), Joe Taslim, and Hiroyuki Sanada, with Karl Urban, Adeline Rudolph, and Tati Gabrielle joining the cast.

synopsis:
In this witty, new breed of mystery, George Hardy (Hugh Jackman) is a shepherd who loves to read detective novels to his beloved sheep every night, assuming they can’t possibly understand him. 

But when a mysterious incident disrupts life on the farm, the sheep realise they must become the detectives and decide to solve the crime themselves, even if it means leaving their meadow for the first time… As they follow the clues and investigate, the sheep have to face the fact that the human world isn't as simple as it appears in books.

The Sheep Detectives boasts an all-star cast including Hugh Jackman, Nicholas Braun, Nicholas Galitzine, Molly Gordon, Hong Chau, and Emma Thompson with the voices of Julia Louis-Dreyfus, Bryan Cranston, Chris O'Dowd, Regina Hall, Patrick Stewart, Bella Ramsey, and Brett Goldstein. This new mystery comedy film based on the 2005 novel Three Bags Full by Leonie Swann is directed by Kyle Balda, written by Craig Mazin, and shows that even sheep can be brilliant crime-solvers.

synopsis:
Based on the 2021 novel by Andy Weir, Project Hail Mary is an exhilarating space adventure set in the near future. 

Science teacher Ryland Grace (Ryan Gosling) wakes up alone on a space station with no recollection of who he is, or how he got there. As his memory returns in bursts, he begins to piece together that he is the sole survivor of a crew sent to the Tau Ceti - a solar system, 12 light-years from Earth.

As details of the mission unravel, Grace must call on all of his scientific training, sheer ingenuity, and human will, to reverse the impact of a space event that hurled the planet into the early stages of an Ice Age… but an unexpected friendship means he may not have to do it alone.

Please be advised that Project Hail Mary contains scenes with flashing lights, which may be unsuitable for guests with photosensitive epilepsy.
tmdb_overview: Science teacher Ryland Grace wakes up on a spaceship light years from home with no recollection of who he is or how he got there. As his memory returns, he begins to uncover his mission: solve the riddle of the mysterious substance causing the sun to die out. He must call on his scientific knowledge and unorthodox ideas to save everything on Earth from extinction… but an unexpected friendship means he may not have to do it alone.

synopsis:
‘A Cornish modern classic. Eerie, heart-breaking, wonderful.’ - Mark Kermode 

When a fishing boat, the Rose of Nevada, lost with all hands 30 years ago, mysteriously reappears in the old harbour of a forgotten Cornish village, for those who remember, it’s surely a sign. The boat must go out to sea again and maybe then the luck of the devastated village will turn. 
Young father Nick (George MacKay) and enigmatic newcomer Liam (Callum Turner) join captain Murgey (Francis Magee), and they head to sea. But when they return, satisfied with their haul, something is amiss — they’ve slipped back in time, and the villagers greet them as if they are the original crew. 

Rose of Nevada is Cornish filmmaker Mark Jenkin’s hotly anticipated and critically acclaimed follow-up to his BAFTA-award-winning first feature Bait (2019) and Enys Men (2022). Unique among British feature filmmakers for the analogue way in which he crafts his films, Jenkin once again serves as writer, director, director of photography, editor, sound designer and score composer.

Beyond screens every Monday matinee and Tuesday evening, showcasing independent films that might not be on your radar (yet!) but are well worth experiencing on the big screen.

synopsis:
In this witty, new breed of mystery, George Hardy (Hugh Jackman) is a shepherd who loves to read detective novels to his beloved sheep every night, assuming they can’t possibly understand him. 

But when a mysterious incident disrupts life on the farm, the sheep realise they must become the detectives and decide to solve the crime themselves, even if it means leaving their meadow for the first time… As they follow the clues and investigate, the sheep have to face the fact that the human world isn't as simple as it appears in books.

The Sheep Detectives boasts an all-star cast including Hugh Jackman, Nicholas Braun, Nicholas Galitzine, Molly Gordon, Hong Chau, and Emma Thompson with the voices of Julia Louis-Dreyfus, Bryan Cranston, Chris O'Dowd, Regina Hall, Patrick Stewart, Bella Ramsey, and Brett Goldstein. This new mystery comedy film based on the 2005 novel Three Bags Full by Leonie Swann is directed by Kyle Balda, written by Craig Mazin, and shows that even sheep can be brilliant crime-solvers.

synopsis:
Based on the 2021 novel by Andy Weir, Project Hail Mary is an exhilarating space adventure set in the near future. 

Science teacher Ryland Grace (Ryan Gosling) wakes up alone on a space station with no recollection of who he is, or how he got there. As his memory returns in bursts, he begins to piece together that he is the sole survivor of a crew sent to the Tau Ceti - a solar system, 12 light-years from Earth.

As details of the mission unravel, Grace must call on all of his scientific training, sheer ingenuity, and human will, to reverse the impact of a space event that hurled the planet into the early stages of an Ice Age… but an unexpected friendship means he may not have to do it alone.

Please be advised that Project Hail Mary contains scenes with flashing lights, which may be unsuitable for guests with photosensitive epilepsy.
tmdb_overview: Science teacher Ryland Grace wakes up on a spaceship light years from home with no recollection of who he is or how he got there. As his memory returns, he begins to uncover his mission: solve the riddle of the mysterious substance causing the sun to die out. He must call on his scientific knowledge and unorthodox ideas to save everything on Earth from extinction… but an unexpected friendship means he may not have to do it alone.

synopsis:
The Magic Faraway Tree follows Polly (Claire Foy), Tim (Andrew Garfield) and their three children - a modern family forced to relocate to the remote English countryside. 

As they adapt to their new lives, the children discover a magical tree and its extraordinary and eccentric residents, including treasured characters Moonface (Nonso Anozie), Silky (Nicola Coughlan), Dame Washalot (Jessica Gunning) and Saucepan Man (Dustin Demri-Burns). At the top of the tree, they are transported to spectacular and fantastical lands and, through the joys and challenges of their adventures, the family learn to reconnect and value each other for the first time in years.

As they follow the clues and investigate human suspects, they prove that even sheep can be brilliant crime-solvers.

synopsis:
As Miranda Priestly (Meryl Streep) nears retirement, she reunites with Andy Sachs (Anne Hathaway) to face off against Emily Charlton (Emily Blunt), her former assistant turned rival, as they compete for advertising revenue amidst declining print media.

Twenty years after making their iconic turns as Miranda, Andy, Emily and Nigel- Meryl Streep, Anne Hathaway, Emily Blunt and Stanley Tucci return to the fashionable streets of New York City and the sleek offices of Runway Magazine in 20th Century Studios’ “The Devil Wears Prada 2,” the eagerly awaited sequel to the 2006 phenomenon that defined a generation.

The Devil Wears Prada 2 reunites the original main cast of Meryl Streep, Anne Hathaway, Emily Blunt, and Stanley Tucci with director David Frankel and writer Aline Brosh McKenna. It also introduces an all-new runway of characters including Kenneth Branagh, Simone Ashley, Justin Theroux, Lucy Lui and more. The film also features an original song ""Runway"" performed by Lady Gaga and Doechii.

synopsis:
In this witty, new breed of mystery, George Hardy (Hugh Jackman) is a shepherd who loves to read detective novels to his beloved sheep every night, assuming they can’t possibly understand him. 

But when a mysterious incident disrupts life on the farm, the sheep realise they must become the detectives and decide to solve the crime themselves, even if it means leaving their meadow for the first time… As they follow the clues and investigate, the sheep have to face the fact that the human world isn't as simple as it appears in books.

The Sheep Detectives boasts an all-star cast including Hugh Jackman, Nicholas Braun, Nicholas Galitzine, Molly Gordon, Hong Chau, and Emma Thompson with the voices of Julia Louis-Dreyfus, Bryan Cranston, Chris O'Dowd, Regina Hall, Patrick Stewart, Bella Ramsey, and Brett Goldstein. This new mystery comedy film based on the 2005 novel Three Bags Full by Leonie Swann is directed by Kyle Balda, written by Craig Mazin, and shows that even sheep can be brilliant crime-solvers.

synopsis:
Based on the 2021 novel by Andy Weir, Project Hail Mary is an exhilarating space adventure set in the near future. 

Science teacher Ryland Grace (Ryan Gosling) wakes up alone on a space station with no recollection of who he is, or how he got there. As his memory returns in bursts, he begins to piece together that he is the sole survivor of a crew sent to the Tau Ceti - a solar system, 12 light-years from Earth.

As details of the mission unravel, Grace must call on all of his scientific training, sheer ingenuity, and human will, to reverse the impact of a space event that hurled the planet into the early stages of an Ice Age… but an unexpected friendship means he may not have to do it alone.

Please be advised that Project Hail Mary contains scenes with flashing lights, which may be unsuitable for guests with photosensitive epilepsy.
tmdb_overview: Science teacher Ryland Grace wakes up on a spaceship light years from home with no recollection of who he is or how he got there. As his memory returns, he begins to uncover his mission: solve the riddle of the mysterious substance causing the sun to die out. He must call on his scientific knowledge and unorthodox ideas to save everything on Earth from extinction… but an unexpected friendship means he may not have to do it alone.

From New Line Cinema comes the latest high-stakes installment in the blockbuster video game franchise in all its brutal glory, serving as a sequel to Mortal Kombat (2021), Mortal Kombat II. ​​

Starring returning cast members Jessica McNamee, Josh Lawson, Ludi Lin, Damon Herriman (in a different role), Joe Taslim, and Hiroyuki Sanada, with Karl Urban, Adeline Rudolph, and Tati Gabrielle joining the cast.

synopsis:
Based on the 2021 novel by Andy Weir, Project Hail Mary is an exhilarating space adventure set in the near future. 

Science teacher Ryland Grace (Ryan Gosling) wakes up alone on a space station with no recollection of who he is, or how he got there. As his memory returns in bursts, he begins to piece together that he is the sole survivor of a crew sent to the Tau Ceti - a solar system, 12 light-years from Earth.

As details of the mission unravel, Grace must call on all of his scientific training, sheer ingenuity, and human will, to reverse the impact of a space event that hurled the planet into the early stages of an Ice Age… but an unexpected friendship means he may not have to do it alone.

Please be advised that Project Hail Mary contains scenes with flashing lights, which may be unsuitable for guests with photosensitive epilepsy.

He must call on his scientific knowledge and unorthodox ideas to save everything on Earth from extinction… but an unexpected friendship means he may not have to do it alone.

The film tells the story of Michael Jackson’s life beyond the music, tracing his journey from the discovery of his extraordinary talent as the lead of the Jackson Five, to the visionary artist whose creative ambition fuelled a relentless pursuit to become the biggest entertainer in the world.

Highlighting both his life off-stage and some of the most iconic performances from his early solo career, the film gives audiences a front-row seat to Michael Jackson as never before. This is where his story begins.

synopsis:
Based on the 2021 novel by Andy Weir, Project Hail Mary is an exhilarating space adventure set in the near future. 

Science teacher Ryland Grace (Ryan Gosling) wakes up alone on a space station with no recollection of who he is, or how he got there. As his memory returns in bursts, he begins to piece together that he is the sole survivor of a crew sent to the Tau Ceti - a solar system, 12 light-years from Earth.

As details of the mission unravel, Grace must call on all of his scientific training, sheer ingenuity, and human will, to reverse the impact of a space event that hurled the planet into the early stages of an Ice Age… but an unexpected friendship means he may not have to do it alone.

Please be advised that Project Hail Mary contains scenes with flashing lights, which may be unsuitable for guests with photosensitive epilepsy.
tmdb_overview: Science teacher Ryland Grace wakes up on a spaceship light years from home with no recollection of who he is or how he got there. As his memory returns, he begins to uncover his mission: solve the riddle of the mysterious substance causing the sun to die out. He must call on his scientific knowledge and unorthodox ideas to save everything on Earth from extinction… but an unexpected friendship means he may not have to do it alone.

synopsis:
‘A Cornish modern classic. Eerie, heart-breaking, wonderful.’ - Mark Kermode 

When a fishing boat, the Rose of Nevada, lost with all hands 30 years ago, mysteriously reappears in the old harbour of a forgotten Cornish village, for those who remember, it’s surely a sign. The boat must go out to sea again and maybe then the luck of the devastated village will turn. 
Young father Nick (George MacKay) and enigmatic newcomer Liam (Callum Turner) join captain Murgey (Francis Magee), and they head to sea. But when they return, satisfied with their haul, something is amiss — they’ve slipped back in time, and the villagers greet them as if they are the original crew. 

Rose of Nevada is Cornish filmmaker Mark Jenkin’s hotly anticipated and critically acclaimed follow-up to his BAFTA-award-winning first feature Bait (2019) and Enys Men (2022). Unique among British feature filmmakers for the analogue way in which he crafts his films, Jenkin once again serves as writer, director, director of photography, editor, sound designer and score composer.
tmdb_overview: A mysterious boat returns to a village 30 years after vanishing. Two men join its crew hoping for better fortune. After one voyage, they find themselves transported back in time, mistaken for the original crew.

synopsis:
As Miranda Priestly (Meryl Streep) nears retirement, she reunites with Andy Sachs (Anne Hathaway) to face off against Emily Charlton (Emily Blunt), her former assistant turned rival, as they compete for advertising revenue amidst declining print media.

Twenty years after making their iconic turns as Miranda, Andy, Emily and Nigel- Meryl Streep, Anne Hathaway, Emily Blunt and Stanley Tucci return to the fashionable streets of New York City and the sleek offices of Runway Magazine in 20th Century Studios’ “The Devil Wears Prada 2,” the eagerly awaited sequel to the 2006 phenomenon that defined a generation.

The Devil Wears Prada 2 reunites the original main cast of Meryl Streep, Anne Hathaway, Emily Blunt, and Stanley Tucci with director David Frankel and writer Aline Brosh McKenna. It also introduces an all-new runway of characters including Kenneth Branagh, Simone Ashley, Justin Theroux, Lucy Lui and more. The film also features an original song ""Runway"" performed by Lady Gaga and Doechii.
tmdb_overview: Miranda Priestly navigates her career amid the decline of traditional magazine publishing. She faces off against Emily Charlton, her one-time assistant, now a high-powered executive for a luxury group, with advertising dollars that Priestly desperately needs.

synopsis:
You are cordially invited to witness the wedding of the year and watch The Drama unfold…

Emma Harwood (Zendaya) is a bookstore clerk from Baton Rouge, Louisiana and soon to be married to Charlie Thompson (Robert Pattison), a British museum director from London. However, the happy couple is put to the test when an unexpected turn sends their wedding week off the rails.
tmdb_overview: A happily engaged couple is put to the test when an unexpected turn sends their wedding week off the rails.

synopsis:
In this witty, new breed of mystery, George Hardy (Hugh Jackman) is a shepherd who loves to read detective novels to his beloved sheep every night, assuming they can’t possibly understand him. 

But when a mysterious incident disrupts life on the farm, the sheep realise they must become the detectives and decide to solve the crime themselves, even if it means leaving their meadow for the first time… As they follow the clues and investigate, the sheep have to face the fact that the human world isn't as simple as it appears in books.

The Sheep Detectives boasts an all-star cast including Hugh Jackman, Nicholas Braun, Nicholas Galitzine, Molly Gordon, Hong Chau, and Emma Thompson with the voices of Julia Louis-Dreyfus, Bryan Cranston, Chris O'Dowd, Regina Hall, Patrick Stewart, Bella Ramsey, and Brett Goldstein. This new mystery comedy film based on the 2005 novel Three Bags Full by Leonie Swann is directed by Kyle Balda, written by Craig Mazin, and shows that even sheep can be brilliant crime-solvers.

synopsis:
As Miranda Priestly (Meryl Streep) nears retirement, she reunites with Andy Sachs (Anne Hathaway) to face off against Emily Charlton (Emily Blunt), her former assistant turned rival, as they compete for advertising revenue amidst declining print media.

Twenty years after making their iconic turns as Miranda, Andy, Emily and Nigel- Meryl Streep, Anne Hathaway, Emily Blunt and Stanley Tucci return to the fashionable streets of New York City and the sleek offices of Runway Magazine in 20th Century Studios’ “The Devil Wears Prada 2,” the eagerly awaited sequel to the 2006 phenomenon that defined a generation.

The Devil Wears Prada 2 reunites the original main cast of Meryl Streep, Anne Hathaway, Emily Blunt, and Stanley Tucci with director David Frankel and writer Aline Brosh McKenna. It also introduces an all-new runway of characters including Kenneth Branagh, Simone Ashley, Justin Theroux, Lucy Lui and more. The film also features an original song ""Runway"" performed by Lady Gaga and Doechii.

synopsis:
After serving a fourteen-year sentence, vicious psychopath Max Cady emerges from prison with a single-minded mission: to seek revenge on his attorney, Sam Bowden. Realising he is legally powerless to protect his wife and teenage daughter against Max's relentless psychological torment, Sam resorts to unorthodox measures, leading to an unforgettable, action-packed showdown.

Screening on Sundays and Wednesdays as part of our Throwback Season, where we revisit classics. Each ticket to these showtimes includes complimentary popcorn and a drink.
tmdb_overview: Sam Bowden is a small-town corporate attorney. Max Cady is a tattooed, cigar-smoking, Bible-quoting, psychotic rapist. What do they have in common? 14 years ago, Sam was a public defender assigned to Max Cady's rape trial, and he made a serious error: he hid a document from his illiterate client that could have gotten him acquitted. Now, the cagey Cady has been released, and he intends to teach Sam Bowden and his family a thing or two about loss.

synopsis:
Algiers, 1938. Meursault, a quiet and unassuming man in his early thirties, attends his mother’s funeral without shedding a tear. The next day, he begins a casual affair with Marie, a colleague, and quickly slips back into his routine. But his seemingly indifferent existence is soon disrupted by his neighbour, Raymond Sintès, who draws Meursault into his murky affairs - until, on one blisteringly hot day, a tragic event unfolds on a sun-drenched beach.

Based on Albert Camus’ groundbreaking 1942 debut novel L’Étranger (published as The Outsider in the UK), which explores themes of human cruelty, existentialism, and post-colonialism, this celebrated French classic has captivated readers in over 75 languages worldwide. François Ozon’s absorbing and stylish film adaptation reimagines the story for a contemporary audience. 

Featuring an extraordinary performance by Benjamin Voisin, the film also showcases an outstanding French cast, including Rebecca Marder (The Crime Is Mine), Pierre Lottin (The Marching Band, When Autumn Falls), Swann Arlaud (Anatomy of a Fall, By the Grace of God), and Denis Lavant (Holy Motors, Beau Travail).

synopsis:
Everyman Members are invited to join us on Wednesday, 13 May, for a special preview screening of Steven Soderbergh's The Christophers.

A mainstay of the London art scene since his starry breakout in the creative explosion of the 1960’s, Julian Sklar (Ian McKellen) has drifted into a cluttered, self-imposed seclusion. His two estranged children (James Corden, Jessica Gunning) enlist Lori (Michaela Coel), a young painter and sometime-forger, to pose as a prospective assistant and gain access to a fabled series of unfinished canvases Julian has buried deep in his home studio, in a deceptive bid to secure an inheritance for themselves.
tmdb_overview: The estranged children of a once-famous artist hire a forger to complete his unfinished works so they can be "discovered" and sold after his death.

synopsis:
In this witty, new breed of mystery, George Hardy (Hugh Jackman) is a shepherd who loves to read detective novels to his beloved sheep every night, assuming they can’t possibly understand him. 

But when a mysterious incident disrupts life on the farm, the sheep realise they must become the detectives and decide to solve the crime themselves, even if it means leaving their meadow for the first time… As they follow the clues and investigate, the sheep have to face the fact that the human world isn't as simple as it appears in books.

The Sheep Detectives boasts an all-star cast including Hugh Jackman, Nicholas Braun, Nicholas Galitzine, Molly Gordon, Hong Chau, and Emma Thompson with the voices of Julia Louis-Dreyfus, Bryan Cranston, Chris O'Dowd, Regina Hall, Patrick Stewart, Bella Ramsey, and Brett Goldstein. This new mystery comedy film based on the 2005 novel Three Bags Full by Leonie Swann is directed by Kyle Balda, written by Craig Mazin, and shows that even sheep can be brilliant crime-solvers.

synopsis:
In this witty, new breed of mystery, George Hardy (Hugh Jackman) is a shepherd who loves to read detective novels to his beloved sheep every night, assuming they can’t possibly understand him. 

But when a mysterious incident disrupts life on the farm, the sheep realise they must become the detectives and decide to solve the crime themselves, even if it means leaving their meadow for the first time… As they follow the clues and investigate, the sheep have to face the fact that the human world isn't as simple as it appears in books.

The Sheep Detectives boasts an all-star cast including Hugh Jackman, Nicholas Braun, Nicholas Galitzine, Molly Gordon, Hong Chau, and Emma Thompson with the voices of Julia Louis-Dreyfus, Bryan Cranston, Chris O'Dowd, Regina Hall, Patrick Stewart, Bella Ramsey, and Brett Goldstein. This new mystery comedy film based on the 2005 novel Three Bags Full by Leonie Swann is directed by Kyle Balda, written by Craig Mazin, and shows that even sheep can be brilliant crime-solvers.
tmdb_overview: George is a shepherd who reads detective novels to his beloved sheep every night, assuming they can't possibly understand. But when a mysterious incident disrupts life on the farm, the sheep realize they must become the detectives. As they follow the clues and investigate human suspects, they prove that even sheep can be brilliant crime-solvers.

synopsis:
After serving a fourteen-year sentence, vicious psychopath Max Cady emerges from prison with a single-minded mission: to seek revenge on his attorney, Sam Bowden. Realising he is legally powerless to protect his wife and teenage daughter against Max's relentless psychological torment, Sam resorts to unorthodox measures, leading to an unforgettable, action-packed showdown.

Screening on Sundays and Wednesdays as part of our Throwback Season, where we revisit classics. Each ticket to these showtimes includes complimentary popcorn and a drink.
tmdb_overview: Sam Bowden is a small-town corporate attorney. Max Cady is a tattooed, cigar-smoking, Bible-quoting, psychotic rapist. What do they have in common? 14 years ago, Sam was a public defender assigned to Max Cady's rape trial, and he made a serious error: he hid a document from his illiterate client that could have gotten him acquitted. Now, the cagey Cady has been released, and he intends to teach Sam Bowden and his family a thing or two about loss.

synopsis:
Everyman Members are invited to join us on Wednesday, 13 May, for a special preview screening of Steven Soderbergh's The Christophers.

A mainstay of the London art scene since his starry breakout in the creative explosion of the 1960’s, Julian Sklar (Ian McKellen) has drifted into a cluttered, self-imposed seclusion. His two estranged children (James Corden, Jessica Gunning) enlist Lori (Michaela Coel), a young painter and sometime-forger, to pose as a prospective assistant and gain access to a fabled series of unfinished canvases Julian has buried deep in his home studio, in a deceptive bid to secure an inheritance for themselves.
tmdb_overview: The estranged children of a once-famous artist hire a forger to complete his unfinished works so they can be "discovered" and sold after his death.

synopsis:
After serving a fourteen-year sentence, vicious psychopath Max Cady emerges from prison with a single-minded mission: to seek revenge on his attorney, Sam Bowden. Realising he is legally powerless to protect his wife and teenage daughter against Max's relentless psychological torment, Sam resorts to unorthodox measures, leading to an unforgettable, action-packed showdown.

Screening on Sundays and Wednesdays as part of our Throwback Season, where we revisit classics. Each ticket to these showtimes includes complimentary popcorn and a drink.
tmdb_overview: Sam Bowden is a small-town corporate attorney. Max Cady is a tattooed, cigar-smoking, Bible-quoting, psychotic rapist. What do they have in common? 14 years ago, Sam was a public defender assigned to Max Cady's rape trial, and he made a serious error: he hid a document from his illiterate client that could have gotten him acquitted. Now, the cagey Cady has been released, and he intends to teach Sam Bowden and his family a thing or two about loss.

synopsis:
In this witty, new breed of mystery, George Hardy (Hugh Jackman) is a shepherd who loves to read detective novels to his beloved sheep every night, assuming they can’t possibly understand him. 

But when a mysterious incident disrupts life on the farm, the sheep realise they must become the detectives and decide to solve the crime themselves, even if it means leaving their meadow for the first time… As they follow the clues and investigate, the sheep have to face the fact that the human world isn't as simple as it appears in books.

The Sheep Detectives boasts an all-star cast including Hugh Jackman, Nicholas Braun, Nicholas Galitzine, Molly Gordon, Hong Chau, and Emma Thompson with the voices of Julia Louis-Dreyfus, Bryan Cranston, Chris O'Dowd, Regina Hall, Patrick Stewart, Bella Ramsey, and Brett Goldstein. This new mystery comedy film based on the 2005 novel Three Bags Full by Leonie Swann is directed by Kyle Balda, written by Craig Mazin, and shows that even sheep can be brilliant crime-solvers.

But when a mysterious incident disrupts life on the farm, the sheep realise they must become the detectives and decide to solve the crime themselves, even if it means leaving their meadow for the first time… As they follow the clues and investigate, the sheep have to face the fact that the human world isn't as simple as it appears in books.

The Sheep Detectives boasts an all-star cast including Hugh Jackman, Nicholas Braun, Nicholas Galitzine, Molly Gordon, Hong Chau, and Emma Thompson with the voices of Julia Louis-Dreyfus, Bryan Cranston, Chris O'Dowd, Regina Hall, Patrick Stewart, Bella Ramsey, and Brett Goldstein. This new mystery comedy film based on the 2005 novel Three Bags Full by Leonie Swann is directed by Kyle Balda, written by Craig Mazin, and shows that even sheep can be brilliant crime-solvers.
tmdb_overview: George is a shepherd who reads detective novels to his beloved sheep every night, assuming they can't possibly understand. But when a mysterious incident disrupts life on the farm, the sheep realize they must become the detectives. As they follow the clues and investigate human suspects, they prove that even sheep can be brilliant crime-solvers.

synopsis:
Michael is the cinematic portrayal of the life and legacy of one of the most influential artists the world has ever known.

The film tells the story of Michael Jackson’s life beyond the music, tracing his journey from the discovery of his extraordinary talent as the lead of the Jackson Five, to the visionary artist whose creative ambition fuelled a relentless pursuit to become the biggest entertainer in the world.

Highlighting both his life off-stage and some of the most iconic performances from his early solo career, the film gives audiences a front-row seat to Michael Jackson as never before. This is where his story begins.

synopsis:
As Miranda Priestly (Meryl Streep) nears retirement, she reunites with Andy Sachs (Anne Hathaway) to face off against Emily Charlton (Emily Blunt), her former assistant turned rival, as they compete for advertising revenue amidst declining print media.

Twenty years after making their iconic turns as Miranda, Andy, Emily and Nigel- Meryl Streep, Anne Hathaway, Emily Blunt and Stanley Tucci return to the fashionable streets of New York City and the sleek offices of Runway Magazine in 20th Century Studios’ “The Devil Wears Prada 2,” the eagerly awaited sequel to the 2006 phenomenon that defined a generation.

The Devil Wears Prada 2 reunites the original main cast of Meryl Streep, Anne Hathaway, Emily Blunt, and Stanley Tucci with director David Frankel and writer Aline Brosh McKenna. It also introduces an all-new runway of characters including Kenneth Branagh, Simone Ashley, Justin Theroux, Lucy Lui and more. The film also features an original song ""Runway"" performed by Lady Gaga and Doechii.
tmdb_overview: Miranda Priestly navigates her career amid the decline of traditional magazine publishing. She faces off against Emily Charlton, her one-time assistant, now a high-powered executive for a luxury group, with advertising dollars that Priestly desperately needs.

synopsis:
The Magic Faraway Tree follows Polly (Claire Foy), Tim (Andrew Garfield) and their three children - a modern family forced to relocate to the remote English countryside. 

As they adapt to their new lives, the children discover a magical tree and its extraordinary and eccentric residents, including treasured characters Moonface (Nonso Anozie), Silky (Nicola Coughlan), Dame Washalot (Jessica Gunning) and Saucepan Man (Dustin Demri-Burns). At the top of the tree, they are transported to spectacular and fantastical lands and, through the joys and challenges of their adventures, the family learn to reconnect and value each other for the first time in years.

synopsis:
Based on the 2021 novel by Andy Weir, Project Hail Mary is an exhilarating space adventure set in the near future. 

Science teacher Ryland Grace (Ryan Gosling) wakes up alone on a space station with no recollection of who he is, or how he got there. As his memory returns in bursts, he begins to piece together that he is the sole survivor of a crew sent to the Tau Ceti - a solar system, 12 light-years from Earth.

As details of the mission unravel, Grace must call on all of his scientific training, sheer ingenuity, and human will, to reverse the impact of a space event that hurled the planet into the early stages of an Ice Age… but an unexpected friendship means he may not have to do it alone.

Please be advised that Project Hail Mary contains scenes with flashing lights, which may be unsuitable for guests with photosensitive epilepsy.
tmdb_overview: Science teacher Ryland Grace wakes up on a spaceship light years from home with no recollection of who he is or how he got there. As his memory returns, he begins to uncover his mission: solve the riddle of the mysterious substance causing the sun to die out. He must call on his scientific knowledge and unorthodox ideas to save everything on Earth from extinction… but an unexpected friendship means he may not have to do it alone.

synopsis:

But when a mysterious incident disrupts life on the farm, the sheep realise they must become the detectives and decide to solve the crime themselves, even if it means leaving their meadow for the first time… As they follow the clues and investigate, the sheep have to face the fact that the human world isn't as simple as it appears in books.

The Sheep Detectives boasts an all-star cast including Hugh Jackman, Nicholas Braun, Nicholas Galitzine, Molly Gordon, Hong Chau, and Emma Thompson with the voices of Julia Louis-Dreyfus, Bryan Cranston, Chris O'Dowd, Regina Hall, Patrick Stewart, Bella Ramsey, and Brett Goldstein. This new mystery comedy film based on the 2005 novel Three Bags Full by Leonie Swann is directed by Kyle Balda, written by Craig Mazin, and shows that even sheep can be brilliant crime-solvers.

synopsis:
Based on the 2021 novel by Andy Weir, Project Hail Mary is an exhilarating space adventure set in the near future. 

Science teacher Ryland Grace (Ryan Gosling) wakes up alone on a space station with no recollection of who he is, or how he got there. As his memory returns in bursts, he begins to piece together that he is the sole survivor of a crew sent to the Tau Ceti - a solar system, 12 light-years from Earth.

As details of the mission unravel, Grace must call on all of his scientific training, sheer ingenuity, and human will, to reverse the impact of a space event that hurled the planet into the early stages of an Ice Age… but an unexpected friendship means he may not have to do it alone.

Please be advised that Project Hail Mary contains scenes with flashing lights, which may be unsuitable for guests with photosensitive epilepsy.

As his memory returns, he begins to uncover his mission: solve the riddle of the mysterious substance causing the sun to die out. He must call on his scientific knowledge and unorthodox ideas to save everything on Earth from extinction… but an unexpected friendship means he may not have to do it alone.

synopsis:
Based on the 2021 novel by Andy Weir, Project Hail Mary is an exhilarating space adventure set in the near future. 

Science teacher Ryland Grace (Ryan Gosling) wakes up alone on a space station with no recollection of who he is, or how he got there. As his memory returns in bursts, he begins to piece together that he is the sole survivor of a crew sent to the Tau Ceti - a solar system, 12 light-years from Earth.

As details of the mission unravel, Grace must call on all of his scientific training, sheer ingenuity, and human will, to reverse the impact of a space event that hurled the planet into the early stages of an Ice Age… but an unexpected friendship means he may not have to do it alone.

Please be advised that Project Hail Mary contains scenes with flashing lights, which may be unsuitable for guests with photosensitive epilepsy.

synopsis:
‘A Cornish modern classic. Eerie, heart-breaking, wonderful.’ - Mark Kermode 

When a fishing boat, the Rose of Nevada, lost with all hands 30 years ago, mysteriously reappears in the old harbour of a forgotten Cornish village, for those who remember, it’s surely a sign. The boat must go out to sea again and maybe then the luck of the devastated village will turn. 
Young father Nick (George MacKay) and enigmatic newcomer Liam (Callum Turner) join captain Murgey (Francis Magee), and they head to sea. But when they return, satisfied with their haul, something is amiss — they’ve slipped back in time, and the villagers greet them as if they are the original crew. 

Rose of Nevada is Cornish filmmaker Mark Jenkin’s hotly anticipated and critically acclaimed follow-up to his BAFTA-award-winning first feature Bait (2019) and Enys Men (2022). Unique among British feature filmmakers for the analogue way in which he crafts his films, Jenkin once again serves as writer, director, director of photography, editor, sound designer and score composer.
tmdb_overview: A mysterious boat returns to a village 30 years after vanishing. Two men join its crew hoping for better fortune. After one voyage, they find themselves transported back in time, mistaken for the original crew.

synopsis:
In this witty, new breed of mystery, George Hardy (Hugh Jackman) is a shepherd who loves to read detective novels to his beloved sheep every night, assuming they can’t possibly understand him. 

But when a mysterious incident disrupts life on the farm, the sheep realise they must become the detectives and decide to solve the crime themselves, even if it means leaving their meadow for the first time… As they follow the clues and investigate, the sheep have to face the fact that the human world isn't as simple as it appears in books.

The Sheep Detectives boasts an all-star cast including Hugh Jackman, Nicholas Braun, Nicholas Galitzine, Molly Gordon, Hong Chau, and Emma Thompson with the voices of Julia Louis-Dreyfus, Bryan Cranston, Chris O'Dowd, Regina Hall, Patrick Stewart, Bella Ramsey, and Brett Goldstein. This new mystery comedy film based on the 2005 novel Three Bags Full by Leonie Swann is directed by Kyle Balda, written by Craig Mazin, and shows that even sheep can be brilliant crime-solvers.

synopsis:
Based on the 2021 novel by Andy Weir, Project Hail Mary is an exhilarating space adventure set in the near future. 

Science teacher Ryland Grace (Ryan Gosling) wakes up alone on a space station with no recollection of who he is, or how he got there. As his memory returns in bursts, he begins to piece together that he is the sole survivor of a crew sent to the Tau Ceti - a solar system, 12 light-years from Earth.

As details of the mission unravel, Grace must call on all of his scientific training, sheer ingenuity, and human will, to reverse the impact of a space event that hurled the planet into the early stages of an Ice Age… but an unexpected friendship means he may not have to do it alone.

Please be advised that Project Hail Mary contains scenes with flashing lights, which may be unsuitable for guests with photosensitive epilepsy.
tmdb_overview: Science teacher Ryland Grace wakes up on a spaceship light years from home with no recollection of who he is or how he got there. synopsis:
Based on the 2021 novel by Andy Weir, Project Hail Mary is an exhilarating space adventure set in the near future. 

Science teacher Ryland Grace (Ryan Gosling) wakes up alone on a space station with no recollection of who he is, or how he got there. As his memory returns in bursts, he begins to piece together that he is the sole survivor of a crew sent to the Tau Ceti - a solar system, 12 light-years from Earth.

As details of the mission unravel, Grace must call on all of his scientific training, sheer ingenuity, and human will, to reverse the impact of a space event that hurled the planet into the early stages of an Ice Age… but an unexpected friendship means he may not have to do it alone.

Please be advised that Project Hail Mary contains scenes with flashing lights, which may be unsuitable for guests with photosensitive epilepsy.

In this witty, new breed of mystery, George Hardy (Hugh Jackman) is a shepherd who loves to read detective novels to his beloved sheep every night, assuming they can’t possibly understand him. 

But when a mysterious incident disrupts life on the farm, the sheep realise they must become the detectives and decide to solve the crime themselves, even if it means leaving their meadow for the first time… As they follow the clues and investigate, the sheep have to face the fact that the human world isn't as simple as it appears in books.

The Sheep Detectives boasts an all-star cast including Hugh Jackman, Nicholas Braun, Nicholas Galitzine, Molly Gordon, Hong Chau, and Emma Thompson with the voices of Julia Louis-Dreyfus, Bryan Cranston, Chris O'Dowd, Regina Hall, Patrick Stewart, Bella Ramsey, and Brett Goldstein. This new mystery comedy film based on the 2005 novel Three Bags Full by Leonie Swann is directed by Kyle Balda, written by Craig Mazin, and shows that even sheep can be brilliant crime-solvers.

synopsis:
The Magic Faraway Tree follows Polly (Claire Foy), Tim (Andrew Garfield) and their three children - a modern family forced to relocate to the remote English countryside. 

As they adapt to their new lives, the children discover a magical tree and its extraordinary and eccentric residents, including treasured characters Moonface (Nonso Anozie), Silky (Nicola Coughlan), Dame Washalot (Jessica Gunning) and Saucepan Man (Dustin Demri-Burns). At the top of the tree, they are transported to spectacular and fantastical lands and, through the joys and challenges of their adventures, the family learn to reconnect and value each other for the first time in years.

synopsis:
Based on the 2021 novel by Andy Weir, Project Hail Mary is an exhilarating space adventure set in the near future. 

Science teacher Ryland Grace (Ryan Gosling) wakes up alone on a space station with no recollection of who he is, or how he got there. As his memory returns in bursts, he begins to piece together that he is the sole survivor of a crew sent to the Tau Ceti - a solar system, 12 light-years from Earth.

As details of the mission unravel, Grace must call on all of his scientific training, sheer ingenuity, and human will, to reverse the impact of a space event that hurled the planet into the early stages of an Ice Age… but an unexpected friendship means he may not have to do it alone.

Please be advised that Project Hail Mary contains scenes with flashing lights, which may be unsuitable for guests with photosensitive epilepsy.
tmdb_overview: Science teacher Ryland Grace wakes up on a spaceship light years from home with no recollection of who he is or how he got there. As his memory returns, he begins to uncover his mission: solve the riddle of the mysterious substance causing the sun to die out. He must call on his scientific knowledge and unorthodox ideas to save everything on Earth from extinction… but an unexpected friendship means he may not have to do it alone.

synopsis: A mainstay of the London art scene since his starry breakout in the creative explosion of the 1960’s, Julian Sklar (Ian McKellen) has drifted into a cluttered, self-imposed seclusion. His two estranged children (James Corden, Jessica Gunning) enlist Lori (Michaela Coel), a young painter and sometime-forger, to pose as a prospective assistant and gain access to a fabled series of unfinished canvases Julian has buried deep in his home studio, in a deceptive bid to secure an inheritance for themselves.
tmdb_overview: The estranged children of a once-famous artist hire a forger to complete his unfinished works so they can be "discovered" and sold after his death.

synopsis:
As Miranda Priestly (Meryl Streep) nears retirement, she reunites with Andy Sachs (Anne Hathaway) to face off against Emily Charlton (Emily Blunt), her former assistant turned rival, as they compete for advertising revenue amidst declining print media.

Twenty years after making their iconic turns as Miranda, Andy, Emily and Nigel- Meryl Streep, Anne Hathaway, Emily Blunt and Stanley Tucci return to the fashionable streets of New York City and the sleek offices of Runway Magazine in 20th Century Studios’ “The Devil Wears Prada 2,” the eagerly awaited sequel to the 2006 phenomenon that defined a generation.

The Devil Wears Prada 2 reunites the original main cast of Meryl Streep, Anne Hathaway, Emily Blunt, and Stanley Tucci with director David Frankel and writer Aline Brosh McKenna. It also introduces an all-new runway of characters including Kenneth Branagh, Simone Ashley, Justin Theroux, Lucy Lui and more. The film also features an original song ""Runway"" performed by Lady Gaga and Doechii.

synopsis:
Based on the 2021 novel by Andy Weir, Project Hail Mary is an exhilarating space adventure set in the near future. 

Science teacher Ryland Grace (Ryan Gosling) wakes up alone on a space station with no recollection of who he is, or how he got there. As his memory returns in bursts, he begins to piece together that he is the sole survivor of a crew sent to the Tau Ceti - a solar system, 12 light-years from Earth.

As details of the mission unravel, Grace must call on all of his scientific training, sheer ingenuity, and human will, to reverse the impact of a space event that hurled the planet into the early stages of an Ice Age… but an unexpected friendship means he may not have to do it alone.

Please be advised that Project Hail Mary contains scenes with flashing lights, which may be unsuitable for guests with photosensitive epilepsy.
tmdb_overview: Science teacher Ryland Grace wakes up on a spaceship light years from home with no recollection of who he is or how he got there. As his memory returns, he begins to uncover his mission: solve the riddle of the mysterious substance causing the sun to die out. He must call on his scientific knowledge and unorthodox ideas to save everything on Earth from extinction… but an unexpected friendship means he may not have to do it alone.

synopsis:
From New Line Cinema comes the latest high-stakes installment in the blockbuster video game franchise in all its brutal glory, serving as a sequel to Mortal Kombat (2021), Mortal Kombat II. ​​

Starring returning cast members Jessica McNamee, Josh Lawson, Ludi Lin, Damon Herriman (in a different role), Joe Taslim, and Hiroyuki Sanada, with Karl Urban, Adeline Rudolph, and Tati Gabrielle joining the cast.

This time, the fan favorite champions of Earthrealm—now joined by Johnny Cage (Karl Urban) himself—are pitted against one another in the ultimate, no-holds barred, gory battle to defeat the dark rule of Shao Kahn (Martyn Ford), whose rise threatens the very existence of the Earthrealm and its defenders.

Chasing Utopia is a feature documentary asking the question everyone should be asking: will AI be humanity's greatest achievement or its greatest downfall? Mo Gawdat spent two years travelling the world - from Shanghai to Riyadh, New York to London - to find out, engaging with the leading minds shaping our future including Yoshua Bengio, Fei-Fei Li, Geoffrey Hinton, Max Tegmark, Elon Musk and Sam Altman. The result is a film that might change the way you see everything

Twenty years after making their iconic turns as Miranda, Andy, Emily and Nigel- Meryl Streep, Anne Hathaway, Emily Blunt and Stanley Tucci return to the fashionable streets of New York City and the sleek offices of Runway Magazine in 20th Century Studios’ “The Devil Wears Prada 2,” the eagerly awaited sequel to the 2006 phenomenon that defined a generation.

The Devil Wears Prada 2 reunites the original main cast of Meryl Streep, Anne Hathaway, Emily Blunt, and Stanley Tucci with director David Frankel and writer Aline Brosh McKenna. It also introduces an all-new runway of characters including Kenneth Branagh, Simone Ashley, Justin Theroux, Lucy Lui and more. The film also features an original song ""Runway"" performed by Lady Gaga and Doechii.
tmdb_overview: Miranda Priestly navigates her career amid the decline of traditional magazine publishing. She faces off against Emily Charlton, her one-time assistant, now a high-powered executive for a luxury group, with advertising dollars that Priestly desperately needs.

synopsis:
Michael is the cinematic portrayal of the life and legacy of one of the most influential artists the world has ever known.

The film tells the story of Michael Jackson’s life beyond the music, tracing his journey from the discovery of his extraordinary talent as the lead of the Jackson Five, to the visionary artist whose creative ambition fuelled a relentless pursuit to become the biggest entertainer in the world.

Highlighting both his life off-stage and some of the most iconic performances from his early solo career, the film gives audiences a front-row seat to Michael Jackson as never before. This is where his story begins.

synopsis: A mainstay of the London art scene since his starry breakout in the creative explosion of the 1960’s, Julian Sklar (Ian McKellen) has drifted into a cluttered, self-imposed seclusion. His two estranged children (James Corden, Jessica Gunning) enlist Lori (Michaela Coel), a young painter and sometime-forger, to pose as a prospective assistant and gain access to a fabled series of unfinished canvases Julian has buried deep in his home studio, in a deceptive bid to secure an inheritance for themselves.
tmdb_overview: The estranged children of a once-famous artist hire a forger to complete his unfinished works so they can be "discovered" and sold after his death.

synopsis:
In this witty, new breed of mystery, George Hardy (Hugh Jackman) is a shepherd who loves to read detective novels to his beloved sheep every night, assuming they can’t possibly understand him. 

But when a mysterious incident disrupts life on the farm, the sheep realise they must become the detectives and decide to solve the crime themselves, even if it means leaving their meadow for the first time… As they follow the clues and investigate, the sheep have to face the fact that the human world isn't as simple as it appears in books.

This new mystery comedy film based on the 2005 novel Three Bags Full by Leonie Swann is directed by Kyle Balda, written by Craig Mazin, and shows that even sheep can be brilliant crime-solvers.

synopsis:
Based on the 2021 novel by Andy Weir, Project Hail Mary is an exhilarating space adventure set in the near future. 

Science teacher Ryland Grace (Ryan Gosling) wakes up alone on a space station with no recollection of who he is, or how he got there. As his memory returns in bursts, he begins to piece together that he is the sole survivor of a crew sent to the Tau Ceti - a solar system, 12 light-years from Earth.

As details of the mission unravel, Grace must call on all of his scientific training, sheer ingenuity, and human will, to reverse the impact of a space event that hurled the planet into the early stages of an Ice Age… but an unexpected friendship means he may not have to do it alone.

Please be advised that Project Hail Mary contains scenes with flashing lights, which may be unsuitable for guests with photosensitive epilepsy.
tmdb_overview: Science teacher Ryland Grace wakes up on a spaceship light years from home with no recollection of who he is or how he got there. As his memory returns, he begins to uncover his mission: solve the riddle of the mysterious substance causing the sun to die out. He must call on his scientific knowledge and unorthodox ideas to save everything on Earth from extinction… but an unexpected friendship means he may not have to do it alone.

synopsis:
‘A Cornish modern classic. Eerie, heart-breaking, wonderful.’ - Mark Kermode 

When a fishing boat, the Rose of Nevada, lost with all hands 30 years ago, mysteriously reappears in the old harbour of a forgotten Cornish village, for those who remember, it’s surely a sign. The boat must go out to sea again and maybe then the luck of the devastated village will turn. 
Young father Nick (George MacKay) and enigmatic newcomer Liam (Callum Turner) join captain Murgey (Francis Magee), and they head to sea. But when they return, satisfied with their haul, something is amiss — they’ve slipped back in time, and the villagers greet them as if they are the original crew. 

Rose of Nevada is Cornish filmmaker Mark Jenkin’s hotly anticipated and critically acclaimed follow-up to his BAFTA-award-winning first feature Bait (2019) and Enys Men (2022). Unique among British feature filmmakers for the analogue way in which he crafts his films, Jenkin once again serves as writer, director, director of photography, editor, sound designer and score composer.
tmdb_overview: A mysterious boat returns to a village 30 years after vanishing. Two men join its crew hoping for better fortune. After one voyage, they find themselves transported back in time, mistaken for the original crew.

As they follow the clues and investigate human suspects, they prove that even sheep can be brilliant crime-solvers.

synopsis:
In this witty, new breed of mystery, George Hardy (Hugh Jackman) is a shepherd who loves to read detective novels to his beloved sheep every night, assuming they can’t possibly understand him. 

But when a mysterious incident disrupts life on the farm, the sheep realise they must become the detectives and decide to solve the crime themselves, even if it means leaving their meadow for the first time… As they follow the clues and investigate, the sheep have to face the fact that the human world isn't as simple as it appears in books.

The Sheep Detectives boasts an all-star cast including Hugh Jackman, Nicholas Braun, Nicholas Galitzine, Molly Gordon, Hong Chau, and Emma Thompson with the voices of Julia Louis-Dreyfus, Bryan Cranston, Chris O'Dowd, Regina Hall, Patrick Stewart, Bella Ramsey, and Brett Goldstein. This new mystery comedy film based on the 2005 novel Three Bags Full by Leonie Swann is directed by Kyle Balda, written by Craig Mazin, and shows that even sheep can be brilliant crime-solvers.

synopsis:
Michael is the cinematic portrayal of the life and legacy of one of the most influential artists the world has ever known.

The film tells the story of Michael Jackson’s life beyond the music, tracing his journey from the discovery of his extraordinary talent as the lead of the Jackson Five, to the visionary artist whose creative ambition fuelled a relentless pursuit to become the biggest entertainer in the world.

Highlighting both his life off-stage and some of the most iconic performances from his early solo career, the film gives audiences a front-row seat to Michael Jackson as never before. This is where his story begins.

synopsis:
As Miranda Priestly (Meryl Streep) nears retirement, she reunites with Andy Sachs (Anne Hathaway) to face off against Emily Charlton (Emily Blunt), her former assistant turned rival, as they compete for advertising revenue amidst declining print media.

Twenty years after making their iconic turns as Miranda, Andy, Emily and Nigel- Meryl Streep, Anne Hathaway, Emily Blunt and Stanley Tucci return to the fashionable streets of New York City and the sleek offices of Runway Magazine in 20th Century Studios’ “The Devil Wears Prada 2,” the eagerly awaited sequel to the 2006 phenomenon that defined a generation.

The Devil Wears Prada 2 reunites the original main cast of Meryl Streep, Anne Hathaway, Emily Blunt, and Stanley Tucci with director David Frankel and writer Aline Brosh McKenna. It also introduces an all-new runway of characters including Kenneth Branagh, Simone Ashley, Justin Theroux, Lucy Lui and more. The film also features an original song ""Runway"" performed by Lady Gaga and Doechii.

The film tells the story of Michael Jackson’s life beyond the music, tracing his journey from the discovery of his extraordinary talent as the lead of the Jackson Five, to the visionary artist whose creative ambition fuelled a relentless pursuit to become the biggest entertainer in the world.

Highlighting both his life off-stage and some of the most iconic performances from his early solo career, the film gives audiences a front-row seat to Michael Jackson as never before. This is where his story begins.

synopsis: After breaking the mysterious “One Wish Willow” to win his crush’s heart, a hopeless romantic finds himself getting exactly what he asked for but soon discovers that some desires come at a dark, sinister price.
tmdb_overview: After breaking the mysterious "One Wish Willow" to win his crush's heart, a hopeless romantic finds himself getting exactly what he asked for but soon discovers that some desires come at a dark, sinister price.

synopsis:
As Miranda Priestly (Meryl Streep) nears retirement, she reunites with Andy Sachs (Anne Hathaway) to face off against Emily Charlton (Emily Blunt), her former assistant turned rival, as they compete for advertising revenue amidst declining print media.

Twenty years after making their iconic turns as Miranda, Andy, Emily and Nigel- Meryl Streep, Anne Hathaway, Emily Blunt and Stanley Tucci return to the fashionable streets of New York City and the sleek offices of Runway Magazine in 20th Century Studios’ “The Devil Wears Prada 2,” the eagerly awaited sequel to the 2006 phenomenon that defined a generation.

The Devil Wears Prada 2 reunites the original main cast of Meryl Streep, Anne Hathaway, Emily Blunt, and Stanley Tucci with director David Frankel and writer Aline Brosh McKenna. It also introduces an all-new runway of characters including Kenneth Branagh, Simone Ashley, Justin Theroux, Lucy Lui and more. The film also features an original song ""Runway"" performed by Lady Gaga and Doechii.
tmdb_overview: Miranda Priestly navigates her career amid the decline of traditional magazine publishing. She faces off against Emily Charlton, her one-time assistant, now a high-powered executive for a luxury group, with advertising dollars that Priestly desperately needs.

synopsis: A mainstay of the London art scene since his starry breakout in the creative explosion of the 1960’s, Julian Sklar (Ian McKellen) has drifted into a cluttered, self-imposed seclusion. His two estranged children (James Corden, Jessica Gunning) enlist Lori (Michaela Coel), a young painter and sometime-forger, to pose as a prospective assistant and gain access to a fabled series of unfinished canvases Julian has buried deep in his home studio, in a deceptive bid to secure an inheritance for themselves.
tmdb_overview: The estranged children of a once-famous artist hire a forger to complete his unfinished works so they can be "discovered" and sold after his death.

synopsis:
In this witty, new breed of mystery, George Hardy (Hugh Jackman) is a shepherd who loves to read detective novels to his beloved sheep every night, assuming they can’t possibly understand him. 

But when a mysterious incident disrupts life on the farm, the sheep realise they must become the detectives and decide to solve the crime themselves, even if it means leaving their meadow for the first time… As they follow the clues and investigate, the sheep have to face the fact that the human world isn't as simple as it appears in books.

The Sheep Detectives boasts an all-star cast including Hugh Jackman, Nicholas Braun, Nicholas Galitzine, Molly Gordon, Hong Chau, and Emma Thompson with the voices of Julia Louis-Dreyfus, Bryan Cranston, Chris O'Dowd, Regina Hall, Patrick Stewart, Bella Ramsey, and Brett Goldstein. This new mystery comedy film based on the 2005 novel Three Bags Full by Leonie Swann is directed by Kyle Balda, written by Craig Mazin, and shows that even sheep can be brilliant crime-solvers.
tmdb_overview: George is a shepherd who reads detective novels to his beloved sheep every night, assuming they can't possibly understand. But when a mysterious incident disrupts life on the farm, the sheep realize they must become the detectives. As they follow the clues and investigate human suspects, they prove that even sheep can be brilliant crime-solvers.

synopsis:
In this witty, new breed of mystery, George Hardy (Hugh Jackman) is a shepherd who loves to read detective novels to his beloved sheep every night, assuming they can’t possibly understand him. 

But when a mysterious incident disrupts life on the farm, the sheep realise they must become the detectives and decide to solve the crime themselves, even if it means leaving their meadow for the first time… As they follow the clues and investigate, the sheep have to face the fact that the human world isn't as simple as it appears in books.

The Sheep Detectives boasts an all-star cast including Hugh Jackman, Nicholas Braun, Nicholas Galitzine, Molly Gordon, Hong Chau, and Emma Thompson with the voices of Julia Louis-Dreyfus, Bryan Cranston, Chris O'Dowd, Regina Hall, Patrick Stewart, Bella Ramsey, and Brett Goldstein. This new mystery comedy film based on the 2005 novel Three Bags Full by Leonie Swann is directed by Kyle Balda, written by Craig Mazin, and shows that even sheep can be brilliant crime-solvers.

But when a mysterious incident disrupts life on the farm, the sheep realize they must become the detectives. As they follow the clues and investigate human suspects, they prove that even sheep can be brilliant crime-solvers.

The Super Mario Galaxy Movie is an animated film based on the world of Super Mario Bros., and follows The Super Mario Bros. Movie, which was released in 2023 and earned more than $1.3 billion worldwide. Both the 2023 film and The Super Mario Galaxy Movie are produced by Chris Meledandri of Illumination and Shigeru Miyamoto of Nintendo.

The film will be co-financed by Universal Pictures and Nintendo and will be released worldwide by Universal Pictures.

The Super Mario Galaxy Movie is directed by returning filmmakers Aaron Horvath and Michael Jelenic, from a screenplay by returning screenwriter Matthew Fogel, with Brian Tyler returning to compose the score.

This new mystery comedy film based on the 2005 novel Three Bags Full by Leonie Swann is directed by Kyle Balda, written by Craig Mazin, and shows that even sheep can be brilliant crime-solvers.

synopsis:
Based on the 2021 novel by Andy Weir, Project Hail Mary is an exhilarating space adventure set in the near future. 

Science teacher Ryland Grace (Ryan Gosling) wakes up alone on a space station with no recollection of who he is, or how he got there. As his memory returns in bursts, he begins to piece together that he is the sole survivor of a crew sent to the Tau Ceti - a solar system, 12 light-years from Earth.

As details of the mission unravel, Grace must call on all of his scientific training, sheer ingenuity, and human will, to reverse the impact of a space event that hurled the planet into the early stages of an Ice Age… but an unexpected friendship means he may not have to do it alone.

Please be advised that Project Hail Mary contains scenes with flashing lights, which may be unsuitable for guests with photosensitive epilepsy.
tmdb_overview: Science teacher Ryland Grace wakes up on a spaceship light years from home with no recollection of who he is or how he got there. As his memory returns, he begins to uncover his mission: solve the riddle of the mysterious substance causing the sun to die out. He must call on his scientific knowledge and unorthodox ideas to save everything on Earth from extinction… but an unexpected friendship means he may not have to do it alone.

synopsis:
Michael is the cinematic portrayal of the life and legacy of one of the most influential artists the world has ever known.

The film tells the story of Michael Jackson’s life beyond the music, tracing his journey from the discovery of his extraordinary talent as the lead of the Jackson Five, to the visionary artist whose creative ambition fuelled a relentless pursuit to become the biggest entertainer in the world.

Highlighting both his life off-stage and some of the most iconic performances from his early solo career, the film gives audiences a front-row seat to Michael Jackson as never before. This is where his story begins.

Twenty years after making their iconic turns as Miranda, Andy, Emily and Nigel- Meryl Streep, Anne Hathaway, Emily Blunt and Stanley Tucci return to the fashionable streets of New York City and the sleek offices of Runway Magazine in 20th Century Studios’ “The Devil Wears Prada 2,” the eagerly awaited sequel to the 2006 phenomenon that defined a generation.

The Devil Wears Prada 2 reunites the original main cast of Meryl Streep, Anne Hathaway, Emily Blunt, and Stanley Tucci with director David Frankel and writer Aline Brosh McKenna. It also introduces an all-new runway of characters including Kenneth Branagh, Simone Ashley, Justin Theroux, Lucy Lui and more. The film also features an original song ""Runway"" performed by Lady Gaga and Doechii.
tmdb_overview: Miranda Priestly navigates her career amid the decline of traditional magazine publishing. She faces off against Emily Charlton, her one-time assistant, now a high-powered executive for a luxury group, with advertising dollars that Priestly desperately needs.

synopsis:
In this witty, new breed of mystery, George Hardy (Hugh Jackman) is a shepherd who loves to read detective novels to his beloved sheep every night, assuming they can’t possibly understand him. 

But when a mysterious incident disrupts life on the farm, the sheep realise they must become the detectives and decide to solve the crime themselves, even if it means leaving their meadow for the first time… As they follow the clues and investigate, the sheep have to face the fact that the human world isn't as simple as it appears in books.

The Sheep Detectives boasts an all-star cast including Hugh Jackman, Nicholas Braun, Nicholas Galitzine, Molly Gordon, Hong Chau, and Emma Thompson with the voices of Julia Louis-Dreyfus, Bryan Cranston, Chris O'Dowd, Regina Hall, Patrick Stewart, Bella Ramsey, and Brett Goldstein. This new mystery comedy film based on the 2005 novel Three Bags Full by Leonie Swann is directed by Kyle Balda, written by Craig Mazin, and shows that even sheep can be brilliant crime-solvers.

synopsis:
Michael is the cinematic portrayal of the life and legacy of one of the most influential artists the world has ever known.

The film tells the story of Michael Jackson’s life beyond the music, tracing his journey from the discovery of his extraordinary talent as the lead of the Jackson Five, to the visionary artist whose creative ambition fuelled a relentless pursuit to become the biggest entertainer in the world.

Highlighting both his life off-stage and some of the most iconic performances from his early solo career, the film gives audiences a front-row seat to Michael Jackson as never before. This is where his story begins.

synopsis:
You are cordially invited to witness the wedding of the year and watch The Drama unfold…

Emma Harwood (Zendaya) is a bookstore clerk from Baton Rouge, Louisiana and soon to be married to Charlie Thompson (Robert Pattison), a British museum director from London. However, the happy couple is put to the test when an unexpected turn sends their wedding week off the rails.
tmdb_overview: A happily engaged couple is put to the test when an unexpected turn sends their wedding week off the rails.

synopsis: A mainstay of the London art scene since his starry breakout in the creative explosion of the 1960’s, Julian Sklar (Ian McKellen) has drifted into a cluttered, self-imposed seclusion. His two estranged children (James Corden, Jessica Gunning) enlist Lori (Michaela Coel), a young painter and sometime-forger, to pose as a prospective assistant and gain access to a fabled series of unfinished canvases Julian has buried deep in his home studio, in a deceptive bid to secure an inheritance for themselves.
tmdb_overview: The estranged children of a once-famous artist hire a forger to complete his unfinished works so they can be "discovered" and sold after his death.

synopsis:
The Magic Faraway Tree follows Polly (Claire Foy), Tim (Andrew Garfield) and their three children - a modern family forced to relocate to the remote English countryside. 

As they adapt to their new lives, the children discover a magical tree and its extraordinary and eccentric residents, including treasured characters Moonface (Nonso Anozie), Silky (Nicola Coughlan), Dame Washalot (Jessica Gunning) and Saucepan Man (Dustin Demri-Burns). At the top of the tree, they are transported to spectacular and fantastical lands and, through the joys and challenges of their adventures, the family learn to reconnect and value each other for the first time in years.
tmdb_overview: A modern family relocates to the countryside where the children discover a magical tree with eccentric residents. They're transported to fantastical lands, rekindling their family bond through adventures.

synopsis:
‘A Cornish modern classic. Eerie, heart-breaking, wonderful.’ - Mark Kermode 

When a fishing boat, the Rose of Nevada, lost with all hands 30 years ago, mysteriously reappears in the old harbour of a forgotten Cornish village, for those who remember, it’s surely a sign. The boat must go out to sea again and maybe then the luck of the devastated village will turn. 
Young father Nick (George MacKay) and enigmatic newcomer Liam (Callum Turner) join captain Murgey (Francis Magee), and they head to sea. But when they return, satisfied with their haul, something is amiss — they’ve slipped back in time, and the villagers greet them as if they are the original crew. 

Rose of Nevada is Cornish filmmaker Mark Jenkin’s hotly anticipated and critically acclaimed follow-up to his BAFTA-award-winning first feature Bait (2019) and Enys Men (2022). Unique among British feature filmmakers for the analogue way in which he crafts his films, Jenkin once again serves as writer, director, director of photography, editor, sound designer and score composer.
tmdb_overview: A mysterious boat returns to a village 30 years after vanishing. Two men join its crew hoping for better fortune. After one voyage, they find themselves transported back in time, mistaken for the original crew.

The film tells the story of Michael Jackson’s life beyond the music, tracing his journey from the discovery of his extraordinary talent as the lead of the Jackson Five, to the visionary artist whose creative ambition fuelled a relentless pursuit to become the biggest entertainer in the world.

Highlighting both his life off-stage and some of the most iconic performances from his early solo career, the film gives audiences a front-row seat to Michael Jackson as never before. This is where his story begins.

synopsis:
As Miranda Priestly (Meryl Streep) nears retirement, she reunites with Andy Sachs (Anne Hathaway) to face off against Emily Charlton (Emily Blunt), her former assistant turned rival, as they compete for advertising revenue amidst declining print media.

Twenty years after making their iconic turns as Miranda, Andy, Emily and Nigel- Meryl Streep, Anne Hathaway, Emily Blunt and Stanley Tucci return to the fashionable streets of New York City and the sleek offices of Runway Magazine in 20th Century Studios’ “The Devil Wears Prada 2,” the eagerly awaited sequel to the 2006 phenomenon that defined a generation.

The Devil Wears Prada 2 reunites the original main cast of Meryl Streep, Anne Hathaway, Emily Blunt, and Stanley Tucci with director David Frankel and writer Aline Brosh McKenna. It also introduces an all-new runway of characters including Kenneth Branagh, Simone Ashley, Justin Theroux, Lucy Lui and more. The film also features an original song ""Runway"" performed by Lady Gaga and Doechii.
tmdb_overview: Miranda Priestly navigates her career amid the decline of traditional magazine publishing. She faces off against Emily Charlton, her one-time assistant, now a high-powered executive for a luxury group, with advertising dollars that Priestly desperately needs.

synopsis:
In this witty, new breed of mystery, George Hardy (Hugh Jackman) is a shepherd who loves to read detective novels to his beloved sheep every night, assuming they can’t possibly understand him. 

But when a mysterious incident disrupts life on the farm, the sheep realise they must become the detectives and decide to solve the crime themselves, even if it means leaving their meadow for the first time… As they follow the clues and investigate, the sheep have to face the fact that the human world isn't as simple as it appears in books.

The Sheep Detectives boasts an all-star cast including Hugh Jackman, Nicholas Braun, Nicholas Galitzine, Molly Gordon, Hong Chau, and Emma Thompson with the voices of Julia Louis-Dreyfus, Bryan Cranston, Chris O'Dowd, Regina Hall, Patrick Stewart, Bella Ramsey, and Brett Goldstein. This new mystery comedy film based on the 2005 novel Three Bags Full by Leonie Swann is directed by Kyle Balda, written by Craig Mazin, and shows that even sheep can be brilliant crime-solvers.

Chasing Utopia is a feature documentary asking the question everyone should be asking: will AI be humanity's greatest achievement or its greatest downfall? Mo Gawdat spent two years travelling the world - from Shanghai to Riyadh, New York to London - to find out, engaging with the leading minds shaping our future including Yoshua Bengio, Fei-Fei Li, Geoffrey Hinton, Max Tegmark, Elon Musk and Sam Altman. The result is a film that might change the way you see everything

synopsis:
In this witty, new breed of mystery, George Hardy (Hugh Jackman) is a shepherd who loves to read detective novels to his beloved sheep every night, assuming they can’t possibly understand him. 

But when a mysterious incident disrupts life on the farm, the sheep realise they must become the detectives and decide to solve the crime themselves, even if it means leaving their meadow for the first time… As they follow the clues and investigate, the sheep have to face the fact that the human world isn't as simple as it appears in books.

The Sheep Detectives boasts an all-star cast including Hugh Jackman, Nicholas Braun, Nicholas Galitzine, Molly Gordon, Hong Chau, and Emma Thompson with the voices of Julia Louis-Dreyfus, Bryan Cranston, Chris O'Dowd, Regina Hall, Patrick Stewart, Bella Ramsey, and Brett Goldstein. This new mystery comedy film based on the 2005 novel Three Bags Full by Leonie Swann is directed by Kyle Balda, written by Craig Mazin, and shows that even sheep can be brilliant crime-solvers.

Michael is the cinematic portrayal of the life and legacy of one of the most influential artists the world has ever known.

The film tells the story of Michael Jackson’s life beyond the music, tracing his journey from the discovery of his extraordinary talent as the lead of the Jackson Five, to the visionary artist whose creative ambition fuelled a relentless pursuit to become the biggest entertainer in the world.

synopsis:
In this witty, new breed of mystery, George Hardy (Hugh Jackman) is a shepherd who loves to read detective novels to his beloved sheep every night, assuming they can’t possibly understand him. 

But when a mysterious incident disrupts life on the farm, the sheep realise they must become the detectives and decide to solve the crime themselves, even if it means leaving their meadow for the first time… As they follow the clues and investigate, the sheep have to face the fact that the human world isn't as simple as it appears in books.

The Sheep Detectives boasts an all-star cast including Hugh Jackman, Nicholas Braun, Nicholas Galitzine, Molly Gordon, Hong Chau, and Emma Thompson with the voices of Julia Louis-Dreyfus, Bryan Cranston, Chris O'Dowd, Regina Hall, Patrick Stewart, Bella Ramsey, and Brett Goldstein. This new mystery comedy film based on the 2005 novel Three Bags Full by Leonie Swann is directed by Kyle Balda, written by Craig Mazin, and shows that even sheep can be brilliant crime-solvers.

The Super Mario Galaxy Movie is an animated film based on the world of Super Mario Bros., and follows The Super Mario Bros. Both the 2023 film and The Super Mario Galaxy Movie are produced by Chris Meledandri of Illumination and Shigeru Miyamoto of Nintendo.

The film will be co-financed by Universal Pictures and Nintendo and will be released worldwide by Universal Pictures.

The Super Mario Galaxy Movie is directed by returning filmmakers Aaron Horvath and Michael Jelenic, from a screenplay by returning screenwriter Matthew Fogel, with Brian Tyler returning to compose the score.
